narrative:
## Handover Summary — PMIS Baseline

Top-down net sales targets are locked at business unit, category and region level, and reconcile to the GBP 13.2B Partnership plan.

## Key Decisions
• Waitrose target lifted on like-for-like momentum and refurbishment uplift
• John Lewis target trimmed to reflect big-ticket softness in Oracle CDC actuals
• Convenience England raised for new-space sales curves

## Recommendation for Sales & Margin Phase
Translate the sales envelopes into gross margin by trading period. Prioritise Electricals price-match exposure and Waitrose waste and markdown trends.

signals.title: PMIS still mastered in Excel
signals.excerpt: Management income statement, budget, forecast and cash flow live in spreadsheets. Reporting-line definitions exist only in workbooks, so every cycle re-reconciles the same numbers.

signals.title: Waitrose Financial Foundations gold data
signals.excerpt: Daily sales, stock and margin modelled to gold standard and already used by the Waitrose Daily Sales CoWork agent. John Lewis equivalent requires foundational work.
